metadata.name: scarcity_exchange
metadata.description: Fully collateralized binary and scalar curve markets for Hedgents.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the configured authority may perform this action.

errors.name: InvalidResolver
errors.msg: The resolver public key is invalid.

errors.name: IssuancePaused
errors.msg: New issuance is paused.

errors.name: InvalidMarketId
errors.msg: The market identifier is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidCommitment
errors.msg: A required content commitment is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidSchedule
errors.msg: The market schedule is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: The amount must be greater than zero.

errors.name: MarketNotOpen
errors.msg: The market is not open yet.

errors.name: MarketClosed
errors.msg: The market is closed to new issuance.

errors.name: MarketResolved
errors.msg: The market has already been resolved.

errors.name: MarketNotResolved
errors.msg: The market has not been resolved.

errors.name: ResolutionTooEarly
errors.msg: The market cannot be resolved yet.

errors.name: WrongCollateralMint
errors.msg: The supplied collateral mint is not accepted.

errors.name: InvalidCollateralDecimals
errors.msg: The collateral mint must use six decimal places.

errors.name: WrongOutcomeMint
errors.msg: The supplied outcome mint does not belong to this market.

errors.name: LosingOutcome
errors.msg: The supplied outcome did not win this market.

errors.name: AmountExceedsLiability
errors.msg: The amount exceeds the market's remaining collateral liability.

errors.name: AmountTooSmall
errors.msg: The amount is too small to produce a payout.

errors.name: ArithmeticOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow or underflow.

errors.name: FeeTooHigh
errors.msg: The configured trading fee exceeds the protocol maximum.

errors.name: InvalidOrderId
errors.msg: The order identifier is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: The outcome price must be greater than zero and no more than one USDC.

errors.name: OrderExpired
errors.msg: The order has expired.

errors.name: WrongEscrowMint
errors.msg: The escrow mint does not match the order side.

errors.name: WrongFeeRecipient
errors.msg: The fee recipient does not match the snapshotted order configuration.

errors.name: WrongOrderSide
errors.msg: The order side does not match this fill instruction.

errors.name: AmountExceedsOrder
errors.msg: The requested fill exceeds the order's remaining quantity.

errors.name: InvalidCurveBucketCount
errors.msg: A curve market must use an odd bucket count between three and forty-one.

errors.name: CurveJackpotTooHigh
errors.msg: The curve jackpot share exceeds the protocol maximum.

errors.name: InvalidCurveValue
errors.msg: The normalized curve value must be between negative one and positive one.

errors.name: InvalidCurveBucket
errors.msg: The curve bucket is outside this market's range.

errors.name: CurveStakeLimitExceeded
errors.msg: The curve stake cap has been reached.

errors.name: AmountExceedsPosition
errors.msg: The requested amount exceeds this curve position's stake.

errors.name: PositionAlreadyClaimed
errors.msg: This curve position has already been claimed.

errors.name: WrongCurveVault
errors.msg: The curve vault does not belong to this market.

errors.name: WrongCurveMarket
errors.msg: The curve position does not belong to this market.

errors.name: InsufficientCurveCollateral
errors.msg: The curve vault does not contain the market's recorded collateral.

errors.name: InvalidCurveDenominator
errors.msg: The curve payout denominator is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidCurveAccounting
errors.msg: The curve market's aggregate stake accounting is inconsistent.

errors.name: CurveRecoveryTooEarly
errors.msg: The resolver recovery delay has not elapsed.

errors.name: DuplicateAccount
errors.msg: Two accounts that must be distinct resolve to the same address.
